name: Shiye · Bookmarks & Notes
subtitle: Save links, notes and files
promotionalText: Bring favorite websites, links, illustrated notes and important files together, with iCloud sync between iPhone and Mac.
description:
Shiye keeps your personal collection of websites, bookmarks, notes and files in one place.

• Websites and groups
Organize frequently visited websites by topic, add notes, search across groups and keep favorites close.

• Bookmarks
Save article and video links, read available titles and descriptions, add notes and one-to-three-star ratings, and filter by platform, date or rating.

• Notes with images
Write down ideas, paste images directly into a note, browse card previews, and view, edit or rate your notes.

• Files
Collect images, documents and other files you choose. Add notes and ratings, preview supported files, or export them.

• Global search
Find groups, websites, bookmarks, note text and file details from one search.

• iPhone and Mac sync
Use the same iCloud account with iCloud enabled to synchronize your collection. Save locally while offline and continue syncing when connected. Transfer timing depends on network conditions, file size, iCloud availability and system scheduling.

• Encrypted backups and settings
Export password-protected backups and merge imports while keeping items unique to the current device. Set a launch password and a group-deletion password, choose day or night mode, and use Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish or Russian.

Link details are supplied by the relevant website and may be unavailable when a site restricts access. iCloud sync requires an Apple Account and available iCloud storage.
